common.quantityBasis: Issued quantities remain source references. The engineering workflow records current measurements and written decisions in separate fields.
common.phasePricing: The issued RFPs ask for project/phase lump sums and hourly rates for authorized extra services, rather than a construction-cost percentage.
common.professionalDelivery: The engineering prime prepares the engineering judgments and municipal deliverables. This workspace supplies source reconciliation, linked records and editable delivery material.

sharedParents.work: Maintain one parent financial record and a cross-RFP location schedule. Reconcile estimates by damaged inventory item before any location allocation is entered.
sharedParents.output: One parent reconciliation with four distinct location sections, each retaining its issued RFP and written source references.
